title: Value Based Education Presentation
text:
Kenya Institute of Curriculum Development
VALUES BASED EDUCATION
Thomas Lickona (1991) says,
that
character education is the
deliberate effort to help people
understand, care about, and act
upon core ethical values.”
 In the book, Educating for
 Character, he argues that :
When we think about the kind of character
we want for our children, it is clear that we
want them to be able to;
 judge what is right
 care deeply about what is right,
do what they believe to be right, even in
the face of pressure from without and
temptation from within.”
WHAT IS VALUES BASED EDUCATION?
 WHY VBE?
In African traditional society, values were instilled
in children through informal education.
However, many children in Kenya today, are
growing up without values and psychosocial
competences (Life Skills) which are needed to
function as responsible citizens.
This to a large extent has led to the noticeable
national values and behavioural crisis amongst the
adults and young people today.
What are value
Values are principles,ideologies,
convictions or standards that influence a
person’s or community’s behaviour or
actions in any situation.
 Values are the inner drive that explain
why a person behave or do what they
do. They determine what a person
considers important in life.
 When combined with knowledge, correct
 attitudes and life skills, values are what
 sustain a person’s conduct/behaviour.
 So Values are important and lasting beliefs
 or ideals shared by the members of a culture
 about what is good or bad and desirable
 or undesirable.

WHAT IS VALUE -BASED EDUCATION
(VbE)?
 It is an approach to teaching that works with
 values.
 It creates a strong learning environment that
 enhances academic attainment
 Develops learners social and relationship skills
 that last throughout their lives.
 VbE equips learners with social capacities
 that help them work with, and relate to
 others effectively.
 It provides them with the self-esteem and
 confidence to explore and develop their full
 potential.
 It leaves no learners behind, irrespective of
 their background.

WHY IS VbE IMPORTANT?
 In a Values-based school, children develop a secure
 sense of self.
 They become more empowered to take
 responsibility for their own learning.
 develop academic diligence when they are involved
 with a Values-based school.
 They develop relational trust.
 They become articulate and able to talk freely and
 well.
 Through silence, quietness and reflectional
 techniques of the Values-based framework,
 children can understand much more deeply their
 work and their lives.
There are 8 core values in the CBC designs
1.Respect 5.Love
2.Patriotism 6.Resposibility
3.Social Justice 7.Peace
4.Unity 8.Integrity
Current KICD Value Based Education
Core Values
 Respect
 • Respect is acceptance of self and others for who you/they are. It is about being true
 to our nature and to those around us. It requires a level of open-mindedness and
 willingness to understand others. Recognizing, respecting and celebrating the
 diversity in others produces trust, confidence and unity.
 • Other Values related to respect include Tolerance, human, Dignity
 Patriotism
 • Patriotism is love, loyalty and devotion shown to one's country.
 • It can support other values such as Democracy and Rule of law
 Social Justice
 • Refers to the idea of creating a society that is based on the principles of
 equality and solidarity, that understands and values human rights, and
 that recognizes the dignity of every human being
 • It encompasses other values such as Equity, equality, human rights
Unity
• Unity is harmony within and among individuals in a group. It is built from a
 shared vision, hope or cause for the common good.
• Non – discrimination, inclusiveness, appreciating diversity
• Love:This is the the way one values something.when one shows love,one
 respects,maintins peace
Responsibility
• Recognizing your role and function within a given group or space, and
 carrying it out to the best of your ability.
• It calls for Accountability, care for self, others, animals , environment,
 property ,community service
Peace
• It’s a state of harmony that fosters understanding, relationships and
 collaboration amongst people.
• It corporates other values such as Compassion, Care, Love and Empathy.
Integrity
Integrity is choosing your thoughts, words and actions based on your
values and not personal gain.
In corporates other values such as Honesty, trustworthiness , transparency .
